scope.row_scope: boundary trace only, not volume FE DoFs

references.one_dimensional: reuse exact binary64 V28 Decimal80/110 moments; qualify only missing full-width frequencies ell0..6
references.contractions: saved Decimal110 moments, independent y-before-x extended arithmetic; no candidate apply/recover/scatter
references.mapping: independent physical periodic edge/face keys, direction and corner representatives
references.native_columns: all native columns at every exact width, incident and maximum tangential frequencies, both sides and coordinate systems
references.denominator: norm of independent reference or scalar complex modulus; binary64 tiny only for zero, no fitted floor

startup: 60s unchanged PSI window and setup precede a new actual CPU observation; actual parent and child require matching boot/process/cpuset/dat/window/source and age <=15s
handoff: one minimal relative-path opt-in package; actual main classes called in P1, independent checker and ready consumer reopen in P2/P3; main volume/internal binding remains separate
